name: Medan
title: Abraham's son by Keturah
summary: Medan was one of the six sons Abraham had with his second wife, Keturah, after Sarah's death. He is regarded as the ancestor of an Arab tribe, and his descendants were sent eastward with gifts, away from Isaac who was the heir to the covenant promises.

keyEvents.title: Birth and lineage
keyEvents.description: Midian was born as the son of Abraham and Keturah. He is mentioned in the genealogy of Abraham's sons with Keturah.

keyEvents.title: Sent Eastward
keyEvents.description: Abraham gave gifts to the sons he had by his concubines and sent them eastward, away from his son Isaac, while he was still living.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Midian's lineage is confirmed in the genealogy of Abraham's descendants through Keturah in Chronicles.
